facts.fact: The joint sector review's aide-mémoire reports that in 2023 the primary and secondary education ministry (MEPS) launched the process of registering pupils with a number (immatriculation des élèves), including the design of the enrolment platform that generates the numbers.

facts.fact: The aide-mémoire reports for 2023 only the launch of the pupil-numbering process and the design of its enrolment platform under MEPS; it names no school using the platform and gives no count of pupils or schools registered.
